headline: Oil Prices Fall as Rising US Crude Inventories Temper Supply Risks
summary: Oil prices fell as data showed an increase in US crude and fuel inventories, though ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and shipping disruptions limited losses.
why: Crude oil inventory data serves as a fundamental benchmark for global energy supply-demand balances, directly affecting oil company revenues and macro inflation.

impacts.name: Crude Oil
impacts.why: Higher inventory levels signal ample near-term supply availability, depressing futures contracts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An increase in weekly US crude and fuel inventories outweighed supply risk premiums stemming from Middle East geopolitical tensions.
